# account

The script's own account: cash, position, fills and open orders.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`account.equity()`](#account-equity) | Cash plus the position valued at the pool price, in TAO. |
| [`account.cash()`](#account-cash) | TAO not invested. |
| [`account.position()`](#account-position) | The current position; `alpha` is 0 when flat. |
| [`account.fills()`](#account-fills) | Every fill so far, oldest first. |
| [`account.openIntents()`](#account-openintents) | Intents still waiting for a fill. |
| [`account.conditionals()`](#account-conditionals) | Active stop, take-profit and trailing-stop orders. |
| [`account.pnl()`](#account-pnl) | Realized profit of closed trades and unrealized profit of the open position, in TAO, fees included. |

### account.equity() {#account-equity}

```ts
account.equity(): number
```

Cash plus the position valued at the pool price, in TAO. 0 in indicator scripts.

## Types

### Position {#position}

The script's position in the market. Long only: `alpha` is 0 when flat.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | `number` | alpha held |
| `avgPrice` | [`Price`](./types#price) | average entry price, fees included (costTao / alpha); 0 when flat |
| `costTao` | `number` | TAO spent on the alpha still held, fees included |
| `unrealizedTao` | `number` | alpha × pool price − costTao |
| `openedBlock` | `BlockNumber \| null` | first block of the bar in which the position was opened; null when flat |

### Fill {#fill}

A completed fill of an intent, as passed to `event.onFill`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intentId` | [`IntentId`](./types#intentid) |  |
| `block` | [`BlockNumber`](./types#blocknumber) |  |
| `time` | [`Ms`](./types#ms) |  |
| `side` | [`Side`](./types#side) |  |
| `tao` | `number` | TAO spent (buy, fee included) or received before the fee (sell) |
| `alpha` | `number` | alpha received (buy) or sold (sell) |
| `price` | [`Price`](./types#price) | average price, fee excluded |
| `fee` | `number` | fee in TAO |
| `impactBps` | `number` | price impact of this fill in basis points (1 bps = 0.01 %) |
| `partial` | `boolean` | only part of the requested size filled |

### Intent {#intent}

An order the script asked for. The engine fills it against the pool at a later block, or rejects or expires it.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`IntentId`](./types#intentid) |  |
| `side` | [`Side`](./types#side) |  |
| `tao?` | `number` |  |
| `alpha?` | `number` |  |
| `maxPrice?` | [`Price`](./types#price) |  |
| `minPrice?` | [`Price`](./types#price) |  |
| `ttlBlocks` | `number` |  |
| `partialOk` | `boolean` |  |
| `reason?` | `string` |  |
| `createdBlock` | [`BlockNumber`](./types#blocknumber) | block in which the script created the intent |
| `status` | `"queued" \| "submitted" \| "filled" \| "partial" \| "rejected" \| "expired" \| "cancelled"` | queued: waiting for its first block; submitted: waiting for a fill; then filled, partial, rejected, expired or cancelled |

### Conditional {#conditional}

A stop, take-profit or trailing-stop order the engine watches. It is cancelled when the position closes, or when it is checked while there is no position.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `kind` | `"stop" \| "takeProfit" \| "trailing"` |  |
| `price?` | [`Price`](./types#price) | trigger price (stop, takeProfit) |
| `trailPct?` | `number` | trail distance in percent (trailing) |
| `high` | `number` | running high since creation (trailing) |
| `alpha` | `number \| "all"` |  |
| `status` | `"active" \| "triggered" \| "cancelled"` |  |
